16 OCTOBER 2026 · FIRST COLLECTION

Six looks.
Your photo, still yours.

Gentle, Warm, Cool, Vivid, Soft Mono and Bold Mono. Independently authored native adjustment recipes, with no third-party presets, LUTs, textures or branded film emulations.

In Adjust, open Filters & Fix → Photo Filters, or expand Photo Filters in the full inspector. Choose a thumbnail and set Strength from 0–100%. Original removes only the filter, preserving other edits. The main editor’s Original comparison still shows the unedited source.

The collection · full strength

Rendered by Ameluma’s shared ImageProcessor using the generated Coastal Hero demo source. Same source, framing and dimensions for every example. These are actual rendered outputs, not CSS effects or invented filter mockups. Lower strength softens any look.

Native controls

Hosted component captures on Mac, iPhone and iPad. The horizontal strip scrolls to all six looks. The production touch presentation includes Done and adapts to a sheet; the component captures below are not full-app screenshots.

Behavior and compatibility

  • Filter and strength are separate sparse editing fields. Exposure, crop, masks, retouching, annotations, watermarks and export settings are preserved.
  • Single-photo and captured batch inputs keep their existing scope. Mixed filters/strength are labelled. Undo/Redo and project persistence use the existing editing model.
  • GIF frames capture their own filter configuration; later workspace filter changes do not silently alter those frames.
  • Preview and export use the same native rendering pipeline. Seven bounded previews render sequentially with cancellation checks; no simultaneous full-resolution source decoding. Private Editing Mode disables the preview renderer’s thumbnail cache.
  • Legacy projects decode with no filter and retain their prior output. New filter-bearing projects require a supporting version to reproduce their look.

Verification

  • Core: 120 tests passed, including strength endpoints/intermediate blending, distinct results, alpha preservation, legacy decoding, sparse removal, PNG export agreement, collisions, invalid strength and original bytes.
  • Full iPhone and iPad targets: 235 tests each, one Photos-permission skip each, zero failures.
  • Focused Mac state/capture tests: 27 passed. The older long mixed native capture test remains outside the focused run.
  • Final preview refinement and native proof captures passed on all three platforms. Loading the picker does not edit the photo, and proof rendering preserves source bytes.
  • Live iPhone Simulator: opened the picker, selected Warm, changed strength to 40%, removed the filter, and closed with Done. Exposure remained zero.
  • Both unsigned Release builds passed. Two release-tool tests passed. Static preflight: zero failures, four submission blockers—public privacy/support URL verification and distribution signatures. Signing unchanged.

Scope and provenance

This is the initial six-look collection, not the proposed future eighteen. All recipe parameters were authored for this repository using existing native adjustment primitives. No competitor presets or assets were copied. Descriptive titles are not a claim of trademark clearance or patented-technique clearance.

The portrait proof is a visual example, not comprehensive aesthetic validation across skin tones, lighting and devices. Physical-device colour, performance and accessibility checks remain. Native Vision-cache and Simulator runtime warnings seen in prior passes are not declared fixed. No accounts, analytics, uploads, processing dependencies, commit, push or publication were introduced.
